author: Lynn Gulledge
text: Jeff took care of business in a timely and professional fashion.  He fixed some general plumbing in the house and also connected our new outside kitchen with the appropriate regular and hoses.

author: Jeff Lovings
text: Called for a clogged up sewer line, i’m 4 hours away, Jeff came within 1 hour to fix the issue and get the renters back up to being able to flush the toilet and take showers. Sent videos and pictures of what the issue was while handling the issue. I highly recommend them for any plumbing issues!

author: Browney Mascow
text: I called Jeff on Sunday afternoon, Mother's Day, he was at my house within 30 minutes and fixed my exploded water bib. Just to get somebody out on a Sunday afternoon was a remarkable. He did excellent work, he's very fair priced, and a knowledgeable plumber, not to mention a good person. I highly recommend him.

author: George
text: If you need help with a gas leak in your home, I would recommend Jeff Sewell's company, Drain Masters, for excellent and prompt service. We recently thought we might have a leak    coming from the gas regulator that attaches to our house. We contacted Jeff, and he came out to inspect immediately. He confirmed that the regulator needed replacing, and gave us a detailed estimate for the repair cost. The work was completed that day in a most efficient and professional manner.

author: Brady Walsh
text: Jeff did an excellent job for us. From the minute he walked in I knew that he knew his business. He diagnosed our problem right away  and articulated how it needed to be fixed. Plus he was very considerate of any inconvenience we were caused both by the repair needed and his doing the repair for us. He is everything you would want for any plumbing repairs.
